The terminal shows no signal and has been offline for about 5 hours. Its last contact was 2026-11-03 17:55. Your other terminal, T1988A, is online.

While you wait, you can check the chip setup [sup-duvidas-06]:
- With the terminal off, open the back cover.
- Insert the chip in the slot marked SIM1 or SIM2, with the metal side facing down.
- Close the cover, turn the terminal on, and wait for it to connect to the data network.
- When the screen shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the terminal is ready.
- Run a communication test to check that the chip is connecting.

You can download the manual for your model from the Getnet manuals page [sup-manual-maquinas-01]. The sources don't include the steps for the communication test or any Wi-Fi setup.

Your two recent declines came from the card issuers, not from a terminal fault. There were 2 declines yesterday (2026-11-02), totaling R$ 285,00:

- **T1988A** is online on Wi-Fi with good signal.
- **T1988B** is offline with no signal. That didn't cause the TX1008 decline, but it may stop new sales from going through.

To repeat a sale, wait 5 minutes or enter a different amount. That rule is stated for the Get Smart, so it may not apply to your terminal. The sources don't give general guidance on what to do about declines beyond that.

I can propose a support ticket for T1988B (reason: no signal). It would only be opened after you confirm it. I can also hand your case to a human agent if you want.

**Chip setup for T1988B** [sup-duvidas-06]:
1. With the machine off, open the back cover.
2. Insert the chip in the SIM1 or SIM2 slot, metal side facing down.
3. Close the cover, turn the machine on and wait for the data network to connect.
4. When it shows a connected network (2G or 3G), the machine is ready. Then run a communication test.

Getnet has downloadable manuals for each model [sup-manual-maquinas-01]. The sources I found don't cover Wi-Fi connection or fixing a weak or missing signal.

- An action proposal that is not confirmed expires after 15 minutes.
- Hand the case to a human agent: opens a case with a ticket number; the agent's reply shows up in this same conversation.
- A decision on an individual case (dispute, block or release of a held amount) belongs to a human agent; the assistant does not decide it.
- Apart from these tools, the assistant does not carry out any action in the system.
- Identifiers the lookups accept: transaction_id = Id da transação (ex.: TX1007) (ex.: TX0000); terminal_id = Id do terminal (ex.: T1988A) (ex.: T0000A).
- Values the lookups and actions accept (closed list: no other value is accepted): get_settlements — period (padrão yesterday): yesterday | today | last_7_days; method: debito | credito | pix · get_transactions — status: all | approved | declined; period (padrão last_7_days): yesterday | today | last_7_days · request_receivables_advance — method: debito | credito | pix · open_support_ticket — reason: sem_conexao | sem_sinal | erro_transacao | outro.
